family_context.name: Feuerwehr – Wache Nachlöschen
family_context.visual_context: mixed timeless retro/contemporary fire brigade: warm brass/red helmets, dark navy cloth with small yellow trim; no human full suits
family_context.relationship_policy: Shared visual worker family only; not a documented historical unit, nor binding pair/state/trio/combat-tier assignments
family_context.satirical_target: Workplace bureaucracy, hierarchy, solidarity, certainty and practical care; fictional HyperNorm residents, not inherent class traits

figuren.name: Brandmeisterin Löschschluss

bild.cell_semantics: logical layout only; not certified crop

figuren.temperament: Can organize an emergency faster than she can admit she needs a rest.
figuren.prompt_auszug: Brandmeisterin Löschschluss, weiblich-read. tall top-heavy ink pear, red firefighter helmet with little brass crest, two subtle lashes, one goo hand holding compact speaking trumpet at flank and other planted on goo hip; broad lifted brow, gritted internal two upper teeth, exhausted determination. Personality: Can organize an emergency faster than she can admit she needs a rest.

bild.cell_semantics: logical layout only; not certified crop
